name: Notation Systems website (Webflow)
description: The public web presence of Notation Systems, hosted on Webflow (site 'notation-systems', English primary locale, no custom domain attached yet, last published 2026-09-03). Reachable through the Webflow Data API, which makes the site a programmable node: pages, CMS collections, assets, forms and publishing. A Webflow Cloud app (tradewind-scm-nextjs, a Next.js + OpenNext starter) is mounted under it.
